en.title: Compilation Order with Topological Sort
en.description:
A dependency [module, prerequisite] means prerequisite is compiled first; each time, choose the lexicographically smallest among the modules that can currently be compiled. If a cycle exists, return IMPOSSIBLE.

See "Input" for the standard I/O conventions and constraints added by this site.
en.input: Module names are distinct and contain no spaces; n,m≤200000, and dependencies are given as pairs.
en.output: Output the compilation order or IMPOSSIBLE.
en.explanation: Kahn topological sort, using a min-heap to decide which module to pick among those available at the same moment.
